Apple___Apple_scab.symptoms: Olive-green to black velvety spots on leaves, turning brown and corky on mature foliage and fruit.
cultural_organic_control: Collect and destroy fallen leaf litter post-harvest to reduce overwintering pseudothecia.
Prune trees to open the canopy for increased airflow and rapid foliar drying.
Apply organic neem oil spray or biocontrol agents (Bacillus subtilis) at green tip stage.
Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation that prolongs leaf wetness.

sources.name: FAO IPM Guidelines for Temperate Fruit Crops
Dr. YS Parmar UHF Solan Horticultural Advisory

scheme_tags: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture - MIDH (check eligibility, details to verify)

Apple___Black_rot.symptoms: Frog-eye leaf spots with purple margins and light brown centres, developing pycnidia and cankers on branches.
cultural_organic_control: Prune out dead wood, cankers, and mummified fruit during winter dormancy.
Disinfect pruning shears between cuts using 70% alcohol solution.
Maintain tree vigour with balanced organic compost to resist wound invasion.

sources.name: FAO IPM Guidelines for Temperate Fruit Crops

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.symptoms: Bright yellow-orange circular lesions on upper leaf surface, producing tiny tube-like aecia on leaf underside.
cultural_organic_control: Remove nearby alternative host plants (wild cedar/juniper trees) within 1 km where feasible.
Plant rust-resistant cultivars in areas with high cedar populations.
Apply sulfur-based organic dusts during pink bud and petal fall stages.

Apple___healthy.symptoms: Leaves are uniform green without chlorotic halos, necrotic lesions, or sporulation.
cultural_organic_control: Continue balanced nitrogen-phosphorus-potassium organic manuring.
Monitor canopy foliage weekly for early season aphids or mite presence.
scheme_tags: PKVY Organic Farming (check eligibility, details to verify)

Blueberry___healthy.symptoms: Normal elliptical green leaves with healthy turgor and clean venation.
cultural_organic_control: Maintain acidic soil pH (4.5 to 5.2) using pine needle or peat mulch.
Ensure uniform soil moisture through root-zone drip irrigation.

Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.symptoms: White talcum-like powdery fungal growth on leaves and shoots, causing upward leaf curling and distortion.
cultural_organic_control: Prune dense shoots to promote sunlight penetration and reduce microclimate humidity.
Apply potassium bicarbonate or horticultural mineral oil sprays early in the morning.
Avoid excess nitrogen fertilizer that induces succulent, mildew-susceptible young flushes.

Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy.symptoms: Vigorous, dark green foliage free from powdery spots, shot holes, or margin chlorosis.
cultural_organic_control: Maintain standard orchard sanitation and mulch tree basins.

Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.symptoms: Small, tan spots with yellow halos expanding into long, rectangular grayish lesions restricted by leaf veins.
cultural_organic_control: Practice deep summer plowing to bury crop residues harboring conidia.
Rotate with non-host dicot crops (soybean, pulses, or groundnut) for at least two seasons.
Select resistant maize hybrids certified by regional agricultural stations.
scheme_tags: NFSM Coarse Cereals (check eligibility, details to verify)

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.symptoms: Cinnamon-brown circular to elongate pustules (uredinia) scattered across upper and lower leaf surfaces.
cultural_organic_control: Plant rust-resistant certified seed varieties early in the season to evade peak spore flights.
Apply biocontrol formulations such as Trichoderma harzianum or botanical sprays at first notice of pustules.
Maintain balanced potash fertilization to strengthen cell walls against fungal penetration.

Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.symptoms: Long, elliptical grayish-green or tan cigar-shaped lesions measuring 2 to 15 cm on middle and upper leaves.
cultural_organic_control: Practice 2-year crop rotation with non-grass legumes.
Plow under or compost post-harvest maize stalks thoroughly.
Avoid high plant densities that trap moisture and reduce airflow within the canopy.

Corn_(maize)___healthy.symptoms: Clean green leaves with healthy parallel venation and normal photosynthetic vigour.
cultural_organic_control: Apply recommended organic FYM and biofertilizers (Azotobacter, PSB).
Ensure drainage channels are clear to prevent waterlogging during monsoon showers.

Grape___Black_rot.symptoms: Small yellowish necrotic spots turning reddish-brown with dark borders and small black dots (pycnidia).
cultural_organic_control: Canopy management: prune and tie canes to ensure open air circulation and sunlight penetration.
Remove mummified berries and infected canes from the vineyard floor.
Apply Bordeaux mixture or copper oxychloride organic sprays before bloom.

Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).symptoms: Tiger-stripe interveinal leaf chlorosis and necrosis with dark brown wood vascular discoloration.
cultural_organic_control: Prune in dry weather to minimize wound infection by fungal spores.
Seal larger pruning cuts with organic wound sealant or vegetable paste.
Uproot and destroy chronically infected, stunted vines to protect neighboring plants.

Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.disease_name: Isariopsis Leaf Spot / Leaf Blight (Phaeoisariopsis clavispora)
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.symptoms: Irregular dark reddish-brown lesions with distinct margins on upper leaf surfaces, spreading from lower canopy.
cultural_organic_control: Remove affected lower leaves during veraison to prevent upward progression.
Apply botanical neem seed kernel extract (NSKE 5%) as an organic preventative spray.

Grape___healthy.symptoms: Broad green palmate leaves free from spots, curling, or downy mildew patches.
cultural_organic_control: Maintain drip fertigation and shoot pinching as per phenological stage.

Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).symptoms: Asymmetrical blotchy mottle chlorosis crossing leaf veins, small upright leaves, twig dieback, and lopsided sour fruit.
cultural_organic_control: Control the vector Asian Citrus Psyllid (Diaphorina citri) using yellow sticky traps and botanical neem sprays.
Plant certified disease-free nursery budded saplings from government-accredited nurseries.
Rogue out severely infected trees to prevent psyllid vector transmission across the grove.
scheme_tags: Mission on Sub-Mission on Plant Protection (check eligibility, details to verify)

Peach___Bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small water-soaked angular spots on leaves turning purple-black and falling out, giving a shot-hole appearance.
cultural_organic_control: Avoid planting in wind-exposed, highly sandy sites without windbreaks.
Apply fixed copper or copper hydroxide organic bactericide before bud break in spring.
Prune out diseased twigs during winter dormancy.

Peach___healthy.symptoms: Glossy lanceolate green leaves without shot holes, leaf curl, or cankers.
cultural_organic_control: Maintain basin mulching and balanced micronutrient fertilization (zinc and iron).

Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small, yellow-green spots on leaves turning dark brown, water-soaked, and causing severe defoliation.
cultural_organic_control: Use certified disease-free seeds or hot-water seed treatment (50°C for 25 minutes).
Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation; use surface drip lines to keep foliage dry.
Rotate with non-solanaceous crops (cereals, legumes) for 2 to 3 years.

Pepper,_bell___healthy.symptoms: Uniform dark green foliage with upright growth, healthy branching, and no mosaic mottle.
cultural_organic_control: Maintain regular fertigation and weed sanitation around field boundaries.

Potato___Early_blight.symptoms: Dark brown to black necrotic spots with characteristic target-like concentric rings on older leaves.
cultural_organic_control: Follow 3-year crop rotation excluding other solanaceous hosts (tomato, eggplant).
Ensure adequate nitrogen and potassium nutrition to avoid early plant stress.
Apply protective copper-based or biofungicide sprays (Trichoderma) at first sign of target spots.

Potato___Late_blight.symptoms: Large, irregular water-soaked pale green lesions rapidly turning dark brown/black with white mildew fuzz on underside under humid conditions.
cultural_organic_control: Plant certified disease-free seed tubers from trusted seed agencies.
Destroy volunteer potato plants and haulms before harvest to prevent tuber infection.
Avoid surface water stagnation; earth up ridges well to provide tuber cover.

Potato___healthy.symptoms: Lush compound green leaves with crisp margin turgor and no water-soaking or blight spots.
cultural_organic_control: Maintain proper earthing up at 30 and 45 days after planting.
Monitor for aphids using yellow water pan traps.

Raspberry___healthy.symptoms: Pinnately compound green leaves with serrated margins free from anthracnose or rust spots.
cultural_organic_control: Trellis canes to maintain canopy openness and avoid soil contact.

Soybean___healthy.symptoms: Trifoliolate green leaves with clean surfaces free from rust, mosaic, or frogeye spots.
cultural_organic_control: Inoculate seed with Bradyrhizobium japonicum culture at sowing.
Maintain field drainage during continuous monsoon showers.
scheme_tags: NFSM Oilseeds (check eligibility, details to verify)

Squash___Powdery_mildew.symptoms: White powdery talc-like fungal patches appearing on upper and lower surfaces of leaves and petioles.
cultural_organic_control: Select resistant hybrid cultivars with powdery mildew tolerance.
Apply potassium silicate, sulfur dust, or dilute milk-spray organic preventative formulations.
Ensure wide vine spacing to maximize sunlight and airflow.

Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.symptoms: Numerous small, irregular purple to dark brown spots on upper leaf surfaces, coalescing to give leaves a scorched look.
cultural_organic_control: Remove older infected leaves post-harvest and incinerate or deeply compost.
Use plastic or straw mulch to prevent soil splashing onto crown foliage.
Irrigate via drip systems rather than overhead sprinklers.

Strawberry___healthy.symptoms: Dark green trifoliolate leaves with distinct dentate margins and healthy crown growth.
cultural_organic_control: Maintain clean straw mulch and runner pruning.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small, dark brown water-soaked angular spots on leaves, often surrounded by yellow halos, causing blossom drop.
cultural_organic_control: Treat seeds with hot water (50°C for 25 min) or certified pathogen-free seed stock.
Sanitize stakes and nursery crates with 5% bleaching powder solution.
Avoid intercultivation when foliage is wet with dew or rain.

Tomato___Early_blight.symptoms: Concentric rings (target board pattern) forming brown-black spots on lower leaves, surrounded by yellow chlorosis.
cultural_organic_control: Remove bottom 30 cm foliage (leaf pruning) as plant matures to prevent soil-contact splash.
Apply protective bio-fungicide (Trichoderma viride or Pseudomonas fluorescens) in root zone.
Rotate with non-solanaceous crops (marigold, maize, pulses) for 2 to 3 years.

Tomato___Late_blight.symptoms: Large, irregular greasy water-soaked lesions turning dark brown to purplish-black with white cottony mildew on undersides during high humidity.
cultural_organic_control: Destroy volunteer plants and infected crop debris immediately upon detection.
Use drip irrigation exclusively; ensure high ridges to avoid standing water.
Apply protective copper-based or Bordeaux mixture organic sprays ahead of prolonged cool, wet forecasts.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.symptoms: Pale green or yellowish spots with indefinite margins on upper leaf surfaces, with olive-brown velvety mold on undersides.
cultural_organic_control: Lower relative humidity inside polyhouses or tunnels below 85% with adequate ventilation.
Space plants widely and prune lower foliage to increase air movement.
Apply biofungicide spray (Bacillus subtilis) at first symptom appearance.

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.symptoms: Numerous small circular spots with dark brown margins and sunken grayish-white centers dotted with tiny black pycnidia.
cultural_organic_control: Stake tomato vines and mulch beds with clean straw to prevent soil-splash onto foliage.
Prune and discard the lowest diseased leaves early in the season.
Avoid handling tomato plants when foliage is wet from morning dew or overhead rain.

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.symptoms: Fine white/yellow stippling on leaf surfaces, fine webbing on undersides, progressing to bronzing and leaf drop.
cultural_organic_control: Spray foliage underside with high-pressure water stream to dislodge mite colonies.
Apply neem oil (0.5% to 1%) or insecticidal potassium soap solutions.
Encourage predatory mites (Phytoseiidae) and ladybird beetles.

Tomato___Target_Spot.symptoms: Small brown water-soaked lesions developing into circular spots with light brown centers and dark brown concentric rings.
cultural_organic_control: Maintain adequate plant spacing and stake vines off the ground.
Remove suckers and lower old foliage to improve canopy aeration.
Avoid overhead irrigation.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.disease_name: Tomato Leaf Curl / Yellow Leaf Curl Virus (TYLCV)
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.symptoms: Severe stunting, erect bushy growth, upward cupping and curling of leaf margins, interveinal chlorosis, and aborted flowers.
cultural_organic_control: Control the vector whitefly (Bemisia tabaci) using yellow sticky traps (15-20 traps/acre).
Grow border crops of 2-3 rows of tall maize, sorghum, or pearl millet as physical barrier.
Spray 5% neem seed kernel extract (NSKE) at weekly intervals during early crop growth.
Rogue out and bury virus-infected seedlings within 30 days of transplanting.
scheme_tags: Sub-Mission on Plant Protection (check eligibility, details to verify)

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.symptoms: Mottling of leaves with alternating light and dark green areas, leaf distortion (shoestring effect), and reduced plant size.
cultural_organic_control: Workers should wash hands with soap and water before handling plants (virus spreads mechanically).
Sterilize pruning knives and tools in 10% trisodium phosphate solution.
Use certified virus-free seed stock and resistant tomato rootstocks/hybrids.

Tomato___healthy.symptoms: Deep green compound leaves with upright growth, healthy branching, and no spotting, chlorosis, or curling.
cultural_organic_control: Maintain regular fertigation, trellising, and preventive monitoring.
Ensure proper root-zone aeration and avoid excessive waterlogging.
